recipes.title: Ship presence
recipes.blurb: Find vessels and port activity in coastal waters.
recipes.question: Is port traffic or vessel presence changing?
analysis: Segment bright/dark vessel targets in SAR imagery over the AOI.
Count targets per pass and compare against the trailing baseline.
verification: Cross-check the count against a second independent SAR pass.
Discard passes whose coverage fraction is below the minimum.
recipes.alert_threshold: Vessel-count z-score above 2.5 versus the trailing window.
pitfalls: Stationary anchored vessels blend into the baseline.
Coastal clutter inflates counts; land masking runs first.

recipes.title: Fire anomaly
recipes.blurb: Spot burn scars and active thermal anomalies.
recipes.question: Are there new burn scars or active fires?
analysis: Threshold thermal bands for active anomalies.
Difference recent vs baseline burned-area maps for new scars.
verification: Confirm new scars with FIRMS hotspots inside the same window.
Reject single-pixel detections below the confidence floor.
recipes.alert_threshold: New burned hectares above 50 ha or hotspot density above 3 per 100 km2.
pitfalls: Cloud cover hides optical burn scars; SAR backscatter change helps.
Solar farms and flares read as thermal anomalies without masking.

recipes.title: Flooding
recipes.blurb: Detect surface-water expansion after heavy rain.
recipes.question: Is flooding expanding beyond the normal water extent?
analysis: Classify open water with NDWI from optical or SAR water masks.
Difference current vs baseline water extent for new inundation.
verification: Cross-check expansion against rainfall accumulations upstream.
Reject shadow/terrain artifacts below the slope threshold.
recipes.alert_threshold: New surface water above 100 ha sustained across two passes.
pitfalls: Rice paddies and seasonal wetlands mimic flood expansion.
Rough SAR seas can false-positive coastal inundation.

recipes.title: Drought
recipes.blurb: Watch rainfall deficits and soil drying.
recipes.question: Is there a drought signal in the rainfall deficit?
analysis: Accumulate CHIRPS rainfall over rolling 30/90-day windows.
Compute the deficit percentile against the seasonal climatology.
verification: Cross-check the deficit against ERA5 reanalysis accumulation.
Require the deficit to persist across consecutive windows.
pitfalls: Single-month dips recover; persistence is the signal.
Gauge-sparse regions lean entirely on satellite estimates.

recipes.title: Reservoir change
recipes.blurb: Measure reservoir and lake surface change.
recipes.question: Is the reservoir surface shrinking or growing?
analysis: Segment the water surface inside the reservoir polygon.
Track area change against the trailing seasonal baseline.
verification: Cross-check area change with radar altimetry where available.
Reject observations with ice or heavy cloud contamination.
recipes.alert_threshold: Surface area more than 2 sigma below the seasonal norm.
pitfalls: Managed releases move the surface without any anomaly upstream.
Emergent vegetation shifts the optical water edge.

recipes.title: Dust risk
recipes.blurb: Flag dust plumes and hazy air intrusions.
recipes.question: Are dust conditions rising toward transport levels?
analysis: Pull dust PM10 and aerosol optical depth from the forecast feed.
Flag hours above the regional transport threshold.
verification: Cross-check the flagged hours against Sentinel-5P aerosol index.
Require wind direction consistency with the source basin.
recipes.alert_threshold: PM10 above 200 ug/m3 or AOD above 1.0 for 6+ hours.
pitfalls: Smoke and dust share the aerosol index; source geography disambiguates.
Forecast feeds drift; verification anchors to observations.

recipes.title: Vegetation decline
recipes.question: Is vegetation greenness declining against the season?
analysis: Compute NDVI composites for current vs baseline windows.
Difference the composites and cluster sustained decline patches.
verification: Cross-check decline patches against rainfall and thermal stress.
Reject patches smaller than the minimum mapping unit.
recipes.alert_threshold: NDVI drop below 0.15 vs baseline over 500+ ha.
pitfalls: Harvest looks identical to decline on naive differencing.
Cloud gaps bias composites; require a minimum clear fraction.
